status: All native startup Boolean combinations, independent storage/HTTP restart and real browser workspace/restart behavior verified. Complete window and quit parity remains unfinished.

verification.knownFailure: Existing processing-batch-controls setter-only backgroundMode 2 comparison; unchanged.
verification.browser: All three choices are initially checked, can be unchecked through the GUI, survive a batch round trip and clean host restart, and still allow each manual Update operation.

behavior.startup: The native MainWindow reader 0x44e850 restores VmQt/auto_palette, auto_segment and auto_contour after constructing the three CustomTimerCheckBoxes. All eight Boolean combinations are independently observed through read-only getters.
behavior.lifetime: Auto-update choices belong to the application window, independent of document, profiles and batch mode. Keep the existing AutoUpdate owner alive across workspace view changes. Persist only checked choices; enabled, pending and deadline remain transient.
behavior.shutdown: Static caller evidence: MainWindow destructor 0x44f0f0 calls window writer 0x44c7d0 first. That writer saves the three checked flags before calling the existing model writer 0x42aac0. OpenVector saves its checked projection on clean idle host shutdown before terminating its worker.
behavior.storage: The canonical processing-preferences file contains selected, batch, outputOptions, autoUpdate, skipReview and quickSave. autoUpdate contains exactly palette, segmentation and smoothing Boolean fields. Missing files use cold defaults. Invalid or older file shapes fail with explicit recovery instructions; no migration or fallback.
behavior.http: GET /api/autoUpdatePreferences returns the checked projection. POST replaces all three Boolean choices atomically after validation, in either idle workspace. Running batch jobs reject mutations. No client chooses a storage path.
behavior.timers: Initialization changes only checked flags. Existing native differential dispatch and re-entry tests must remain unchanged and pass. Seeded unchecked boxes have no pending work or armed deadlines.

referenceLimitations: The native window writer and destructor were inspected statically, not executed by this observer. The probe seeds only its private registry namespace before startup; it invokes no widget setters and synthesizes no native input.
